title: The Book button opens booking on a Space that has bookable services, instead of an empty membership page

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21 on production: /spaces/house-of-fates/book (10 active services) and /spaces/danny-kenduck/book (2 services) both render 'Become a member'; Danny's page says 'No membership tiers yet'. EntityCta picks the surface from the Focus alone (lib/spaces/cta-kind.ts ctaKindFor); the P0.5 setup prompt only helps the owner. A visitor pressing Book now on a Space that has services and hours meets a dead end. Fix: when the Space has at least one active service and one window, booking leads (or the membership surface carries a Book a time door). Expected lift: every Book now press on these Spaces, today all lost.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
